name: @hl-bos/playtime-engine
description: The game participation engine. Given a log of timestamped game events, it derives the game clock, who is on the field, how long every athlete has actually played, and whether a user-configured minimum participation target is being met. Pure TypeScript: no UI, no database, no timers. Built to be reused by AthleteHuddle, CoachesHuddle, OrganizationHuddle, GameTracker and 5-Star Sports Media, not only by PlayTime Tracker.
